title: 3d-neurons-segmentation: code for the XSoma3D dataset and benchmark
description:
Code accompanying the article “XSoma3D a large scale neuronal dataset revealing cross species generalization in label free microscopy”. It contains the training code of the benchmarked methods (nnU-Net v2, 3D U-Net, StarDist3D, Cellpose 3, Cellpose-SAM, micro-SAM), the evaluation scripts and the neuroseg package, which downloads the XSoma3D dataset from Zenodo, loads the trained models from Hugging Face and reproduces the reported test results, including the transfer and pooling experiments of nnU-Net v2 and Cellpose-SAM.

Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19812777. Trained models: https://huggingface.co/Podtyazhki1337/3d-neurons-segmentation.
